speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: You may look now. A cuff will not lift it. I have tried the corner, which is the vain part of a roll, and the vain part held.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will look, and I will not admire. If the three mouths of it agree, the morning has done what eightpence was for.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Look, and then be painted at two, in the other play. This king is Thursday week. I do not want him rehearsed into this afternoon by a man who cannot leave a trestle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can leave a trestle. The coat is stitched. The boy is cold in the yard, as I asked. I am looking because a stale cue is a cheaper disaster than a wet one, and I will not buy either.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Gaunt first, since you will do it in order and scold me if I offer you the Queen out of turn. The sign is in the corner. I am not going to say what it looks like.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Say nothing about the sign, and say nothing about the coat. The book is shut. One line. I am taking it off the chest before someone thinks of a second.
